## Caption
ROI from Tony Robbins “ Unleash the Tower Within “

Not trying to be materialistic… but actually why not!

Everything we do in life is an investment… time and money go in and out all the time!

And even if you do not spend any money on Developing your skills, or body… you pay for that - but more with the Opportunity Cost.

How much money will you be able to make if you could and the list continues…

In Dubai real estate… it’s more usual to invest in 

Fancy 🚘, or Bags, or watches ⌚️. And - some time the money that you do not even have!!!

I was kinda always a bit Different - No Bentley, no LV bag🤣.

First big money I’ve made I invested in MBA - it’s 2016 University of Wollongong and 5 sessions a week with a personal trainer- no Joke did it in October 2016 both.

And because I wanted to be on a Safe side I stayed in sharing accommodation till the next April!!! I didn’t care - about “attributes” 

Instead of “Wanting to Have” - “ I wanted to Become!”

And becoming is a process that never stops!!!

Tony event was my LV bag…

No offense ladies… 

#dubaisalestrainer
